items.label: Safer New Version Adapters
items.value: Our new upgraded adapters feature over-discharge, no-load disconnect, over-current and low voltage protection. When the output current is more than Resistive Loads 20A or the output voltage is less than 15V, the product will cut off the output and turn off automatically when the adapter is empty. Safer circuit setup and ABS + V0 fireproof base material protect your battery from damage!

items.label: Portable 20V LED Work Light
items.value: This work light is 48W and a brightness of 4800 lumens with a color temperature of 6500K, 120-140°beam angle design, with the latest LED lighting chips and aluminum panels, fast heat dissipation, and high brightness, becoming the outdoor lighting tool of choice

items.label: 3 Fast Charging Ports
items.value: Cordless flashlight 20V work light can charge 3 devices at once. 2 USB-A Ports & 1 Type-C charging port supports fast charging for cell phones, tablets, and other electronic devices. When charging with a single port, USB-A output: QC 18W Max, Type-C output： PD 30W Max

items.label: Wide Application
items.value: This cordless LED work light is easy to carry, perfect for working in dark environments, such as outdoor emergency lighting, camping, hiking, vehicle maintenance, and many other occasions, providing you with an efficient and reliable lighting solution
